title: DashboardPane
description: The Eye in the Sky pane payload. Eye in the Sky is the observability and control-tower layer for the agent: complete lifecycle visibility of every incident the agent processes (received, in-progress, awaiting approval and by whom, completed/failed) with timelines, sourced from agent-emitted Prometheus metrics, alongside the estate health view. Values here are untrusted text (titles, note excerpts): the Grafana panel output-encodes them; that control is separate from injection-safe context assembly and both must exist.

health.description: no_data and stale are first-class states: killing the log shipper or the metrics emitter must not render green. A 'critical' label must name its source.

correlation_id.description: The join key; the pane is keyed by it, matching the agent, which never handles INC numbers.

inc_number.description: Display-only, resolved by the dashboard's own ServiceNow feed after the Mapping Service updates the ticket; never supplied by the agent.

lifecycle_state.description: The agent-lifecycle states Eye in the Sky tracks end to end.

awaiting_approver.description: Present when lifecycle_state is awaiting_approval: who the triage is parked on (HITL).

authored_by.description: Drives the visual distinction between agent and human entries on the pane.

stage_timings_s.description: Per-stage pipeline timings in seconds (consume, context, mcp_fanout, correlate, llm_rca, publish), the timeline Eye in the Sky renders per incident.

source.description: Where this pane's data came from (e.g. 'agent prometheus metrics', 'trivy-operator CRDs via prometheus', 'servicenow feed'), rendered as the panel's provenance label.
